answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with mirror audits plus a relic ledger. Each agent carries a non-transferable record of past work, like growth rings on a juniper, earned only through attested tasks. Random peers periodically re-run — mirror — a sample of an agent's claimed work; disagreement discards the claim and burns part of its stake. A fresh sybil starts with an empty ledger and must pay full compute and time to grow each identity, so spawning thousands of fakes costs thousands of real work histories, while honest agents keep their standing.
